testCase.name: [本地] S20 Visual lane: Important Points states under axe, labels and focus, on phone profiles and WebKit

descriptionHtml:
缺陷 A1 · P2 · 无障碍

按钮 / 输入框 / 下拉框没有可访问名称（养老院的 +、设置、返回、关闭 X、任务完成 / 删除、用药状态下拉等），附带部分焦点跳顶、点按区域太小

票：— · 算 QA bug：是 · 在哪发现：本地（视觉巡检）

同一个 bug的其他用例（只算一次）：OAT-01/S21, OAT-06/S24b, TC-03/S21, TC-11/S20, TC-14/S22, TC-19/S21, TC-21/S20, TC-22/S20

思路 / Approach · TC-12 Important Points · S20 「视觉车道：Important Points 各种状态下的 axe、标签和焦点，在手机配置和 WebKit 上」 Visual lane: Important Points states under axe, labels and focus, on phone profiles and WebKit

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U7 Every step is repeated in Nursing Home and must pass in both modes.（UAT TC-12；UAT 3.3；TFA-92590 AC 3） — gate: blocked: TFA-92590 in progress
  • U2 Three points added via '+ Add Point', one per line, show as three separate cards, not one merged card, in both Hospital and Nursing Home (Nursing Home per PR #57).（UAT TC-12；TFA-92590 AC 3） — gate: blocked: TFA-92590 in progress
  • U4 Editing one point and deleting another both work, in both modes, and the result is what is stored.（UAT TC-12；TFA-92590 AC 5） — gate: blocked: TFA-92590 in progress

测试设计方法：无障碍（accessibility） — 按读屏、键盘、对比度、点按尺寸的规则（axe）查，残障用户也要能用。

Given Hospital editor open with the S04 twelve points (one card in edit mode, the Add Point box open); Nursing Home Pre-Round tab with three cards, and its editor open; Chromium desktop, iPhone 15 (393x852, WebKit) and Pixel 7 (Chromium) profiles

When The visual lane opens each state, runs axe and the explicit label and focus checks, scrolls the points list and takes screenshots

Then No serious or critical WCAG 2 A/AA violations; Edit point / Delete point / Cancel edit have accessible names; each point textarea (Add Point and edit) has aria-label, aria-labelledby or a <label> (a placeholder does not count); after clicking Add Point focus is in that textarea, and after Save Point or Cancel it returns to Add Point or the new card. …

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：axe-core: zero serious or critical (visual-checks.ts). axe's 'label' rule accepts a non-empty placeholder, so the label check is explicit: the textarea's accessible name comes from aria-label / aria-labelledby / <label>, not the placeholder. Focus: document.activeElement after each click. …

在哪跑：本地 visual lane（截图 + axe）；测试方法 VISUAL · 视觉（截图给人看）；矩阵里排的车道 视觉 / 移动端（blocked）

S20 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-12.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

分诊（2026-10-14）：1 条。

问题分类：无障碍 · 环境 本地 · 票 TFA-92590 in progress

Add Point 和编辑要点的输入框只有占位文字当标签（医院编辑框连这个都没有），点 Save Point 或 Cancel 后键盘焦点跳回页面顶部，养老院手机上的编辑/删除图标只有 17×17 px。

The Add Point and edit-point boxes are labelled only by placeholder, and the Hospital edit box has no label at all. Keyboard focus drops to the top of the page after Save Point or Cancel, and the Nursing Home edit and delete icons are 17×17 px on phones.

依据：allure c16872e7, visual lane: 56 passed, 36 failed. Fails WCAG 2.4.3 (focus order) and 2.5.8 (target size). The layout passes: 12 points scroll, a 500-character point wraps, and the buttons are named.

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane visual。

测试方法：VISUAL · 视觉（截图给人看） — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：visual。

UAT item: TC-12 Important Points · Section: A2 · Pre-Round · Scenario: TC-12/S20

Visual lane: Important Points states under axe, labels and focus, on phone profiles and WebKit

Tickets: TFA-92590 Important Points (in progress)

本地新 lane visual：visual/results.json 里 status failed → 失败·产品（失败·产品（lane 标了产品问题））。

怎么测（visual/plan.json，automatable: partly）：preround.spec.ts: Hospital editor with the S04 twelve points (scroll, 500-char point, edit mode, Add Point open, Save Point / Cancel focus) and NH tab with three points + Add Point + editor; axe, button names, strict textarea labels (placeholder does not count), focus via document.activeElement, phone visibility/reach. — The iOS keyboard covering the box is a device check (S22).

Detail:

desktop, iphone15, pixel7: 56 judged check(s) passed, 36 failed. 12 points scroll inside their box to QA-PT-11 and 'K'; the 500-character point wraps and its end is visible; Edit point / Delete point / Cancel edit are named; focus goes into the Add Point box when it opens.

产品问题：The Add Point and edit-point textareas are labelled only by placeholder (Hospital edit box has none) — oracle requires aria-label/labelledby/<label>. After Save Point or Cancel, keyboard focus is dropped to the page body instead of returning to Add Point or the new card (WCAG 2.4.3), so a keyboard / switch user must start over from the top. On phones the NH Edit point / Delete point icons are 17×17 px, side by side (< 24 px, no spacing exception).

证据：附了 7 个；没附 1 个：

  • visual/evidence/TC-12_S20 — 目录（45 项），不附

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane V: visual-lane.ts reads a make-session.ts fixture (a fresh local account made with the admin key), and make-session.ts refuses dev, so it runs on the local stack only (2026-10-14).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
